name: West Pendulum Steppe
core_rationale: Western wind-swept pendulum gorge of Continent 02 where Krono the Brass Titan's metronome counterweight swings across a chasm of singing copper reeds.
local_conflict: Wind-up gale-hounds and metronome-constructs patrol the brass suspension cables spanning the pendulum gorge.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Glider scouts claim that if you catch the updraft of the Great Pendulum's swing at noon, you can soar straight across the chasm without flapping once.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A sun-burnished brass pendulum disk thirty meters wide swinging silently between twin copper cliff-faces.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What subterranean vault opens only at the exact second the Great Pendulum reaches its western apex?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-brass-titan and scar-brass-faultline along the western pendulum gorge of Continent 02.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A colossal sun-burnished brass pendulum swinging between twin copper cliffs of singing reeds.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: brass suspension-bridge and wind-shelter doorway metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved as the western pendulum gorge District frontier on Continent 02 with zero filler maps.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook (in_world_rumor, visual_silhouette, unanswered_question) and empty grid_nodes.
